primary.description: Rich Terracotta for CTAs, reflecting the warmth of Indian spices.

background.description: Warm off-white (stone-50) base to give an earthy, natural feel.

rules: Never use Inter or default generic fonts for headings.
Labels and small functional text should be uppercase and widely tracked.

grid_patterns.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12

general_rules: Use generous padding around text blocks.
Mobile-first responsive design, ensure readable sizes at 375px.
Images on mobile should not exceed max-h-[80vh].

surface_styles.solid_card: bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have clear hover states with contrast change.
interactions.focus: High contrast ring for focus states.

header.style: Glassmorphism header fixed at the top (z-50).
header.content: Logo, Links (About, Menu, Gallery, Contact), 'Call Now' CTA.

hero.style: Full viewport height relative container with background image and black/40 overlay.

content.badge: 4.4★ on Google (945+ Reviews) styled as a glass pill.
content.heading: Late-Night Andhra Comfort on Bannerghatta Rd
content.subheading: Open daily 11 AM - 2 AM. Specializing in authentic Andhra meals and our famous Narmada Special Chicken Biryani.

about.style: Side-by-side layout (image and text) with asymmetric overlap.
about.content: Story of Narmada, emphasizing family dining and late-night availability.

menu_services.style: Cardless or flat solid cards with subtle 1px border. Use list layout for menu items.
menu_services.content: Highlight items: 'Narmada Special Chicken Biryani', 'Andhra Meals'. Include pricing (₹200-400).

gallery.style: Bento Grid (Mode A: The Tetris Grid) for visual tension.
gallery.content: Mix of food photography and warm interior shots.

testimonials.style: Marquee strategy - Option A (The Editorial Ribbon) with slow scroll.
testimonials.content: Customer reviews mentioning late-night food and Biryani.

contact.style: Two-column bento box. Darker background for contrast.
contact.content: Phone (+91 97430 00923) with tel: link. Address, Open Hours, Google Maps embed.

footer.style: Dark background (Stone-900) with Light text. Massive spacing.
footer.content: Quick links, social icons, brand sign-off.

icons.usage: Use consistently for CTAs, contact info, and rating badge.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the defined typography (Cormorant Garamond + Manrope) and colors.
Implement the bento grid for the gallery.
Ensure the hero image has a sufficient overlay (black/40) so the text is fully legible.
Use purely semantic HTML + Tailwind CSS for marketing layouts; customize Shadcn UI only if complex interactives are needed.
All interactive elements (links, buttons, inputs) must have a `data-testid` attribute.
The header must use the glassmorphism surface style.
